##### Project general facts

Beverly Boulevard is a contemporary residential development designed with a focus on modern simplicity and urban sophistication. The architecture reflects a clean and elegant design language, combining sleek lines with warm, neutral tones to create a balanced and inviting atmosphere. The project offers a selection of thoughtfully designed studio, one, and two-bedroom apartments, each planned to maximise space, comfort, and functionality while maintaining a refined and modern aesthetic.

The development offers a vibrant, wellness-focused lifestyle supported by a wide range of leisure and fitness amenities. Residents can enjoy jogging and walking tracks, a fitness studio, outdoor gym, and a dedicated yoga space, along with relaxing features such as swimming pools, jacuzzi pit, baja shelf, and cabanas. Social and recreational areas including a barbecue space with kitchen facilities and a paddle tennis court provide opportunities for community interaction, creating a dynamic environment suited for both relaxation and active living.

Inside, Beverly Boulevard features interiors defined by minimalism and elegant finishes, creating functional yet stylish living spaces. The apartments are designed with clean lines and a modern aesthetic that enhances comfort and everyday usability. Kitchens come fully equipped, offering practicality for daily living, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their own preferences and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

This project boldly inscribed in the heart of the city has some of the major destinations such as Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Hills Mall and Burj Khalifa district (Downtown) in close proximity and can be reached within 15-20 minutes.  
While offering environment friendly infrastructure with community living bliss, Beverly Boulevard also provides easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, which makes for delightful city connectivity. Beverly Boulevard is indeed, a smart choice for the new-age Dubai.

Arjan is a residential community located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.
